title: Build a small reading list
summary: A form and a reactive array can work together.
introduction: A form and a reactive array can work together. Your task: Add two books and explain why their ids differ.
learningObjectives: Add two books and explain why their ids differ.
Explain the example for build a small reading list

blocks.text: A form and a reactive array can work together. Each submitted title becomes a new item with its own stable id.
Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Build a small reading list

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.
`v-model` keeps the form value and Vue state connected in both directions.
`v-for` creates a page part for each list item. A unique stable `:key` helps Vue keep track of the right item.

blocks.text: Submitting a non-empty title adds it to the list and clears the field. Reloading resets this in-memory list.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: This sample does not save to disk or a server. State alone does not provide long-term storage.
